what_this_is: Quantity-only summary of the polygon incidence table and the Short Form flags table built for reconciliation rows U and C (R4 accesses 1 to 3, D-107). PROVISIONAL: the design stands as of 2026-11-18 and the pre-analysis plan is a DRAFT, not frozen. No price, revenue or bill was read. The TYPE mapping is the agent's reading, not a ruling.

territory_layer.note: in no fetch manifest; size and hash recorded as found on 2026-11-19

incidence_table.area_units: square kilometres in EPSG:5070 (NAD83 / Conus Albers equal-area)
incidence_table.containment: geopandas.sjoin(points, polygons, predicate='within'): the point lies in the polygon's interior and not on its boundary, which is the paper's 'strictly contains'; the same predicate, projection and buffer(0) repair as build_inventory.assign_utility, except that polygons with a non-numeric ID are kept here and listed, where the build drops them
incidence_table.sites_source: data/interim/facilities.parquet fid, lat, lon (every row, crypto included)

COMMUNITY CHOICE AGGREGATOR.why: names an aggregation arrangement; the text does not say retail or wholesale-only service

COOPERATIVE.why: names an ownership or governance type; it does not name retail service or wholesale-only service. That such utilities usually sell at retail is outside knowledge, not the value's text

FEDERAL.why: names an ownership or governance type; it does not name retail service or wholesale-only service. That such utilities usually sell at retail is outside knowledge, not the value's text

MUNICIPAL MKTG AUTHORITY.why: names a municipal marketing authority; 'marketing' does not say retail or wholesale-only service

POLITICAL SUBDIVISION.why: names an ownership or governance type; it does not name retail service or wholesale-only service. That such utilities usually sell at retail is outside knowledge, not the value's text

STATE.why: names an ownership or governance type; it does not name retail service or wholesale-only service. That such utilities usually sell at retail is outside knowledge, not the value's text

WHOLESALE POWER MARKETER.why: the only value whose text names wholesale, but it names a wholesale marketer and not wholesale ONLY; reading it as a territory with no retail service would add 'only' from outside the text. The nearest candidate for wholesale_only, left for the session and Joe

ambiguous_values_and_the_sites_they_woul.rule_u: retail polygons first; the smallest retail polygon where several contain the site; unassigned where only wholesale-only polygons contain it (R5 as adopted, D-107)
ambiguous_values_and_the_sites_they_woul.rule_c: the smallest polygon over every territory in the layer, whatever its type

short_form_flags.kept_as_found: rows sharing a unit and year are all kept in the table, not collapsed; the consumer decides

notes: Whether the short_form flag in core_eia861__yearly_operational_data_misc is what Ryu and Hiatt mean by Short Form filers (endnote 10, p. 17) is NOT established; nothing here asserts it.
These are filing flags, not prices.

short_form is True on 1,038 rows, all in 2019, and missing on every other row; it is never False. Rows per year fall from about 3,270 in 2011 to about 2,190 in 2012. The agent's reading, not established: utilities that filed the Short Form may be absent from this table in most years rather than flagged, so a missing flag cannot be read as 'not a Short Form filer'. reconciliation_mu.run_u_step refuses a missing short_form for an outcome unit-year, so it would refuse this table as it stands; how to read a missing flag or an absent row is not decided here.
An ambiguous TYPE value is carried as ambiguous; nothing here treats it as retail or as wholesale-only.
